# Pull requests must not be submitted to the assignments repository. ⚠️

You may open pull requests on your own fork of the assignments repository, but you must not submit pull requests to the assignments repository itself.

If you discover a mistake or wish to suggest changes, please use the Issues tab on the assignments repository or contact the course staff directly.

You may delete the template file `.github/pull_request_template.md` in your fork to remove this warning message.
